faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.disclaimer: Spend-based indicative calculation only. Not a CSRD/ESRS-compliant report, not audited, and not a substitute for a full emissions inventory.
faq.q0: Do clients, banks or procurement teams accept the document?
faq.a0: Yes. Certif-Scope is used across onboarding, procurement checks and ESG screening when indicative CO₂e information is required. It is not an audited or regulatory emissions report, but a standardized structure that reviewers can compare consistently.
faq.q1: How long does it take to generate the document?
faq.a1: Once annual spending (€) is entered, the Attestation is generated in under one minute. No consultants, no delays, and no manual calculations.
faq.a2: A structured PDF including CO₂e indicators, category breakdown, dataset version, timestamp, verification ID and a deterministic integrity hash. Designed for procurement and ESG workflows.
faq.a3: Verification is deterministic and does not require any stored database. Reviewers scan the QR code or enter the verification ID to confirm authenticity. No login or backend lookup is needed.
faq.a4: A transparent spend-based calculation aligned with Scope 3 Category 1 principles. Only financial spending (€) is used. Not CSRD/ESRS-compliant and not intended to replace a full emissions inventory.
faq.a5: No. Inputs are processed during generation and never retained. Verification relies on embedded cryptographic integrity, ensuring privacy without storing any spending data.
faq.a6: This is an indicative spend-based estimation. Not audited, not CSRD/ESRS-compliant, no Scope 1 or 2, and depends entirely on the spending data provided by the user.
